components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid pill-shaped button for primary actions (Next, Modify).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #6a4053; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.75rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Small pill-shaped tag for semantic statuses.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tag-success { background-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2); color: #166534; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Soft rounded rectangle for forms and search bars.
components.css: .ds-input-text { width: 100%; border: 1px solid rgba(106, 64, 83, 0.2); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6a4053; background-color: transparent; } .ds-input-text:focus { outline: 2px solid #6a4053; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Macro Card
components.description: Large white container with ambient shadow for main content areas.
components.css: .ds-card-macro { background-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(106, 64, 83, 0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(106, 64, 83, 0.1); }

narrative.overview: The visual system is warm, inviting, and graceful. It balances highly tactile pill shapes for actions with soft rounded rectangles for data entry.
keyCharacteristics: Soft geometries: Extensive use of pill shapes for actions, and soft rounded rectangles (8-12px) for inputs and cards.
Ambient Depth: Very soft drop shadows lift primary content cards, while sticky navigation elements utilize glassmorphism (translucency + background blur).
Semantic Clarity: Statuses use clear, bright semantic colors (green, yellow, red) as pill-shaped tags to stand out against the warm, muted palette.

rules.name: The Action Pill vs Form Rectangle Rule
rules.body: Buttons and tags are always full pills (rounded-full). Inputs, search bars, and textareas are standard soft rectangles (rounded-lg).

rules.name: Ambient Depth Rule
rules.body: Main content cards (white) must use a very soft, diffused drop shadow over the Light Cream background to provide gentle separation.

rules.name: The Glassmorphism Nav
rules.body: Sticky elements like the bottom nav bar should use a translucent dark plum background with a backdrop blur, revealing content behind it softly.

dos: Do use soft rounded rectangles (rounded-lg) for text inputs and search bars.
Do use ambient, soft drop shadows for main white cards.
Do use glassmorphism (bg-opacity + backdrop-blur) for sticky navigation bars.
donts: Don't use pill shapes for standard text inputs or textareas; reserve pills for actions (buttons) and metadata (tags).
